sophie (oncall): getting a spike of "missing escalation metadata" alerts from the notify queue, pages are going to the generic 'ops-team' route instead of primary oncall. noticed ~10 pages in last 5m
riyad (sre): ugh, seen similar once when the enrichment service timed out and returned empty `escalation_key`
sophie (oncall): attaching sample webhook body:
```\n{\n  "alert_id": "A-12345",\n  "payload": {...},\n  "escalation_metadata": null\n}\n```
julia (eng): can you paste the last error from enrich service logs?
sophie (oncall): from notify-ingest: `failed to enrich alert A-12345: upstream enrichment: 503 Service Unavailable`
alerts-bot: automated note: 5 new pages routed to fallback channel #ops-team (reaction :warning:)
mario (support): customers reported multiple delayed pages — one customer support case opened, tagging @mario
sophie (oncall): paging SLO impacted: pages delayed/misrouted for ~12m window starting 19:18 UTC
riyad (sre): step 1: enable manual fallback switch to send raw payload through legacy router (runbook step)
ops-runbook-bot: runbook 'fallback-legacy-routing' invoked by riyad — confirming manual override enabled
julia (eng): looks like a deploy of enrichment v2 at 19:10 rolled out new JSON schema that fails when third-party responds slowly
sophie (oncall): temp mitigation: riyad enabled legacy route, I'm manually re-paging affected oncall groups now
riyad (sre): I'm rolling back enrichment v2 to v1 on the staging cluster then will flip prod if tests pass
julia (eng): can reproduce locally with a slow 503 from enrichment mock — patch incoming to tolerate empty metadata and fallback gracefully
sophie (oncall): noted customer impact: 3 customers had delayed alert acknowledgements, one SLA ticket created (CS-983)
mario (support): CS-983: customer impact note added, reached out to customers proactively :phone:
alerts-bot: deploy detected: enrichment-service v2 -> v1 rollback started by riyad at 19:31 UTC
riyad (sre): rollback finished at 19:36 UTC, monitoring routing metrics now
sophie (oncall): routing counts look back to normal, no new fallback pages in last 4m
julia (eng): pushed hotfix to tolerate null `escalation_metadata` and added metrics for enrichment latency, PR 4321
riyad (sre): will leave legacy fallback on for 1 hour then remove if stable — creating a short-lived alert to catch regressions
ops-runbook-bot: alert 'enrichment-fallback-detect' created and assigned to sophie (oncall)
sophie (oncall): assigning followups: julia to merge post-deploy tests, riyad to run postmortem draft, mario to update CS tickets
mario (support): will send customer follow-up with timeline and mitigation steps
julia (eng): I'll add a canary and graceful degrade path in the enricher, also add unit test for empty metadata
sophie (oncall): TL;DR: root cause = enrichment v2 returned 503s -> null escalation metadata -> router sent to generic fallback. Impact: delayed/misrouted pages for ~12m, limited customer impact, mitigated by rollback + manual fallback. Next: postmortem, add integration test, and make fallback automatic when enrichment latency > 1s
riyad (sre): thanks everyone. tagging for postmortem: @julia, @sophie, @mario. I'll start the incident doc and timeline now. :white_check_mark:
